_comment: Hugging Face Dataset Viewer on 2026-09-02. Direct downloads of the corpus
are egress-blocked (A-09), so this is a SAMPLE recorded by hand, not a
fetched artefact. It is the evidence for experiment 009 and run.py analyses
only what is committed here, so the analysis reproduces byte-identically
even though the fetch does not.
Total rows in the corpus, per the viewer: 1398177.
_desync_comment: Two pairs where the English at row i is a translation of the Tigrinya at
row i-26. Both were visible inside a single 40-row window at offset 300000,
which is why the constant lag is legible at all. Chosen as evidence because
each carries a language-independent anchor: a leading verse number in the
first, transliterated proper nouns in the second.
